notes: Four matching bugs found in two real reports. A band whose own name holds the separator is no longer cut in half (AC/DC, Belle & Sebastian, Earth, Wind & Fire). One name written two ways now agrees with itself — "Siouxsie and the Banshees" against "Siouxsie & The Banshees" was 42 albums refused over a spelling. A leading "The" and a trailing "Trio"/"Quartet" are no longer different artists. And a trailing tag that only repeats the title's own words or the artist's name is ignored, so "Always Let Me Go - Live In Tokyo (Live In Tokyo)" matches while "Rio (Live)" is still correctly refused. About 450 albums across the two reports.
